3500.meaning1: not criticizing others; not blaming other people

examples.text: ye'pi samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakā sabrahmacārīhi sampayojetvā sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvattanti te'pi satthu c'eva vaṇṇavādino honti, dhammassa ca vaṇṇavādino honti, saṅghassa ca vaṇṇavādino honti, attagarahino'y'eva honti anaññagarahino

3501.meaning1: not different; not otherwise; unfailing; certain
3501.construction:
na > an + añña + thā + a
anaññathā + a

examples.text: iti ime dasa dhammā bhūtā tacchā tathā avitathā anaññathā sammā tathāgatena abhisambuddhā.

3502.grammar: fem, abstr, from na aññatha, neg
3502.meaning1: absolute certainty; fact of not being otherwise
3502.construction:
na > an + añña + thā + a + tā
anaññatha + tā

examples.text: passathā'ti c'āha avijjāpaccayā, bhikkhave, saṅkhārā. iti kho, bhikkhave, yā tatra tathatā avitathatā anaññathatā idappaccayatā, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, paṭiccasamuppādo.

3503.meaning1: accurate; true; as it really is
3503.meaning2: not otherwise, accurately, as it really is
3503.commentary: (THIa) saccavādivacanaṃ anaññathā'ti saccavādino avitathavādino sammāsambuddhassa sabbaṃ rūpaṃ aniccaṃ jar'ābhibhūtan'tiādivacanaṃ anaññathā yathābhūtam'eva, na tattha vitathaṃ atthī'ti.

examples.text: kāḷakā bhamaravaṇṇasādisā, vellit'aggā mama muddhajā ahuṃ, te jarāya sāṇavākasādisā, saccavādivacanaṃ anaññathā.

3505.grammar: adj, comp, from na aññadattha, neg
3505.meaning1: not for another purpose; not for the benefit of another
3505.construction:
na > an + añña + [d] + attha + ika
anaññadattha + ika

3506.meaning1: perceiving (something) as not for another purpose

3507.meaning1: not led by others; not guided by another
3507.meaning2: not to be led by someone else; not needing guidance from anyone else
3507.commentary: (SNPa) anaññaneyyo'ti aññehi idaṃ saccaṃ, idaṃ saccan'ti na netabbo. etena sayambhutaṃ dīpeti, patte vā paccekabodhiñāṇe aneyyatāya abhāvā sayaṃvasitaṃ. samathavipassanāya vā diṭṭhivisūkāni upātivatto, ādimaggena patto niyāmaṃ, sesehi paṭiladdhamaggo, phalañāṇena uppannañāṇo, taṃ sabbaṃ attanā'va adhigato'ti anaññaneyyo.

examples.text: diṭṭhīvisūkāni upātivatto, patto niyāmaṃ paṭiladdhamaggo, uppannañāṇo'mhi anaññaneyyo, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

3508.meaning2: whither one cannot be guided by others

3509.meaning1: not nurturing another; (comm) (or) not supporting another state of existence
3509.commentary: (SNa) anaññaposī'ti ṭhapetvā imaṃ attabhāvaṃ aññassa attabhāvassa vā puttadārassa vā aposanatāya anaññaposī.

examples.text: eso hi te brāhmaṇi brahmadevo, nirūpadhiko atidevapatto, akiñcano bhikkhu anaññaposī, yo te so piṇḍāya gharaṃ paviṭṭho.

3510.meaning1: perceiving as not something else; regarding (something) as not another

3511.meaning1: with no other refuge; independent of others
3511.commentary: (SNa) anaññasaraṇā'ti idaṃ aññassa saraṇapaṭikkhepavacanaṃ. na hi añño aññassa saraṇaṃ hoti aññassa vāyāmena aññassa asijjhanato, vuttam'pi c'etaṃ

examples.text: attadīpā viharatha attasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā

tīṇ'imāni, bhikkhave, indriyāni. katamāni tīṇi? anaññātañ'ñassāmī't'indriyaṃ, aññ'indriyaṃ, aññātāv'indriyaṃ, imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi indriyānī'ti. etam'atthaṃ bhagavā avoca. tatth'etaṃ iti vuccati.
katamehi pañcahi? kathaṃ paribhoti, kathikaṃ paribhoti, attānaṃ paribhoti, duppañño hoti jaḷo eḷamūgo, anaññāte aññātamānī hoti.

3513.meaning1: faculty that senses 'I will know the unknown'
3513.construction: na > an + aññāta + ñassāmi + iti + indriya

examples.text: tīṇ'imāni, bhikkhave, indriyāni. katamāni tīṇi? anaññātañ'ñassāmī't'indriyaṃ, aññ'indriyaṃ, aññātāv'indriyaṃ, imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi indriyānī'ti. etam'atthaṃ bhagavā avoca. tatth'etaṃ iti vuccati.
saddh'indriyaṃ, viriy'indriyaṃ, sat'indriyaṃ, samādh'indriyaṃ, paññ'indriyaṃ, anaññātañ'ñassāmī't'indriyaṃ, aññ'indriyaṃ, aññātāv'indriyaṃ.

3514.meaning1: not lost; not perished; not destroyed
3514.commentary: (VINa) anaṭṭhe naṭṭhasaññī'ti attano cīvarena saddhiṃ bahūni aññesaṃ cīvarāni ekato ṭhapitāni corā haranti. tatr'esa attano cīvare anaṭṭhe naṭṭhasaññī hoti. esa nayo avinaṭṭh'ādīsu'pi.

examples.text: avissajjite vissajjitasaññī, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. anaṭṭhe naṭṭhasaññī, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. avinaṭṭhe vinaṭṭhasaññī, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
yo ve anaṭṭhaṃ'va naṭṭhan'ti c'āha, kāme'va so labhataṃ bhuñjatañ'ca, agāramajjhe maraṇaṃ upetu, yo vā bhonto saṅkati kañci'd'eva.

3516.meaning1: debt free; without debt; without obligation
3516.commentary: (THIa) anaṇā bhuñja piṇḍakan'ti kilesaiṇaṃ pahāya anaṇā hutvā raṭṭhapiṇḍaṃ bhuñjeyyāsi. yo hi kilese appahāya satthārā anuññātapaccaye paribhuñjati, so sāṇo paribhuñjati nāma. yath'āha āyasmā bākulo, satt'āham'eva kho ahaṃ, āvuso, sāṇo raṭṭhapiṇḍaṃ bhuñjin'ti (ma. ni. 3.211). tasmā sāsane pabbajitena kāmacchandādiiṇaṃ pahānāya anaṇena hutvā saddhādeyyaṃ paribhuñjitabbaṃ.

examples.text: mutte muccassu yogehi, cando rāhuggahā iva, vippamuttena cittena, anaṇā bhuñja piṇḍakan'ti.
s'āyaṃ bhujissā anaṇā, bhikkhunī bhāvit'indriyā, sabbayogavisaṃyuttā, katakiccā anāsavā.

3518.meaning1: unbent; without inclination; epithet of Nibbāna
3518.commentary: (UDa) anatan'ti rūp'ādiārammaṇesu, kāmādīsu ca bhavesu namanato tanninnabhāvena pavattito sattānañ'ca tattha namanato taṇhā natā nāma, n'atthi ettha natā'ti anataṃ, nibbānan'ti attho.

examples.text: duddasaṃ anataṃ nāma, na hi saccaṃ sudassanaṃ, paṭividdhā taṇhā jānato, passato n'atthi kiñcanan'ti.
anatañ'ca vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi, anatagāmiñ'ca maggaṃ. taṃ suṇātha.

3519.meaning1: leading to the uninclined; going to the unbent

examples.text: anatañ'ca vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi, anatagāmiñ'ca maggaṃ. taṃ suṇātha.

3523.meaning1: not gone beyond; not surpassed; not exceeded

examples.text: das'āh'ātikkante vematiko, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. das'āh'ātikkante anatikkantasaññī, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. anadhiṭṭhite adhiṭṭhitasaññī, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

3524.grammar: nt, abstr, from na atikkanta, neg
3524.meaning1: fact of not being past; fact of not having overcome
3524.construction:
na > an + ati + √kam + ta + tta
anatikkanta + tta

examples.text: yo'pi c'ettha katakusalo hoti, tam'pi ñātirogabhogabyasan'ādīnaṃ aññatarena byasanena samannāgataṃ disvā vā sutvā vā tesaṃ abhāve'pi vaṭṭadukkhaṃ anatikkantattā, dukkhito'va ayan'ti.

3525.meaning1: perceiving (something) as not kept more than one day

3526.meaning1: perceiving as not having passed; recognizing (something) as not exceeding
3526.commentary: (VINa) das'āh'ātikkante atikkantasaññī'ti das'āhaṃ atikkante cīvare atikkantaṃ idan'ti evaṃsaññī, das'āhe vā atikkante atikkanto das'āho'ti evaṃsaññī.

examples.text: das'āh'ātikkante vematiko, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. das'āh'ātikkante anatikkantasaññī, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

3527.meaning2: not passing; not going beyond; not transgressing

3528.meaning1: not to be transgressed; not to be breached
3528.meaning2: not to be passed; not to be transgressed (against)
3528.meaningLit: not to be gone too far

examples.text: ajja't'agge ovaṭo bhikkhunīnaṃ bhikkhūsu vacanapatho, anovaṭo bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīsu vacanapatho, ayam'pi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo'ti.

3529.grammar: prp of na atikkamati, neg, trans (+acc)
3529.meaning1: not exceeding; not overstepping; not going beyond

3530.grammar: prp of na atikkamati, neg, trans (+acc)
3530.meaning1: (of a rule or boundary) not transgressing; not overstepping; not breaking

3531.grammar: abs of na atikkamati, neg, trans (+acc)
3531.meaning1: having not overstepped; having not walked past
3531.construction:
na > an + ati + √kam + itvā
na + atikkamitvā

3532.grammar: abs of na atikkamati, neg, trans (+acc)
3532.meaning1: having not gone beyond; having not crossed over
3532.construction:
na > an + ati + √kam + itvā
na + atikkamitvā

examples.text: anāpatti mahallake ghare piṭṭhasaṅghāṭassa hatthapāsaṃ avijahitvā nisīdati, khuddake ghare piṭṭhivaṃsaṃ anatikkamitvā nisīdati, bhikkhu dutiyo hoti, ubho nikkhantā honti, ubho vītarāgā, nasayanighare, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

3533.grammar: fem, abstr, from na aticarati, neg
3533.commentary: (DNa) anaticariyāyā'ti taṃ atikkamitvā bahi aññāya itthiyā saddhiṃ paricaranto taṃ aticarati nāma, tathā akaraṇena.

examples.text: pañcahi kho, gahapatiputta, ṭhānehi sāmikena pacchimā disā bhariyā paccupaṭṭhātabbā, sammānanāya anavamānanāya anaticariyāya issariyavossaggena alaṅ'kār'ānuppadānena.

3534.commentary: (DNa) anaticārinī'ti sāmikaṃ muñcitvā aññaṃ manasā'pi na pattheti.

examples.text: imehi kho, gahapatiputta, pañcahi ṭhānehi sāmikena pacchimā disā bhariyā paccupaṭṭhitā pañcahi ṭhānehi sāmikaṃ anukampati, susaṃvihitakamm'antā ca hoti, saṅgahitaparijanā ca, anaticārinī ca, sambhatañ'ca anurakkhati, dakkhā ca hoti analasā sabbakiccesu.
siyā ca nesaṃ kantār'āvaseso anatiṇṇo

3537.grammar: prp of na atimaññati, neg, trans (+acc)
3537.meaning1: not despising; not scorning; not looking down (on); not having contempt (for); not being condescending (towards)
3537.commentary: (ANa) kapālaṃ anatimaññamāno'ti taṃ bhikkhābhājanaṃ anatimaññamāno. so hi puṇṇapattaṃ ādāya sīsaṃ nhāto kuladvāresu ṭhatvā ahaṃ aṭṭhacattālīsa vassāni komārabrahmacariyaṃ cariṃ, mantā'pi me gahitā, ācariyassa ācariyadhanaṃ dassāmi, dhanaṃ me dethā'ti yācati. taṃ sutvā manussā yathāsatti yathābalaṃ aṭṭha'pi soḷasa'pi satam'pi sahassam'pi denti. evaṃ sakalagāmaṃ caritvā laddhadhanaṃ ācariyassa niyyādeti. taṃ sandhāy'etaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: tattha ca, doṇa, ko dhammo? n'eva kasiyā na vaṇijjāya na gorakkhena na issatthena na rājaporisena na sipp'aññatarena, kevalaṃ bhikkhācariyāya kapālaṃ anatimaññamāno.

3538.grammar: masc, abstr, from na atimaññati, neg

examples.text: thaddhassa purisapuggalassa atthaddhiyaṃ hoti parikkamanāya, atimānissa purisapuggalassa anatimāno hoti parikkamanāya, dubbacassa purisapuggalassa sovacassatā hoti parikkamanāya
agiddhilobhaṃ nissāya giddhilobho pahātabbo. anindārosaṃ nissāya nindāroso pahātabbo. akkodh'ūpāyāsaṃ nissāya kodh'ūpāyāso pahātabbo. anatimānaṃ nissāya atimāno pahātabbo.

3539.meaning1: who is not conceited; who is not arrogant; who is humble

examples.text: karaṇīyam'atthakusalena, yantaṃ santaṃ padaṃ abhisamecca, sakko ujū ca sūjū ca, suvaco c'assa mudu anatimānī.
pare atimānī bhavissanti, mayam'ettha anatimānī bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.

3540.commentary: (VIN 2.5.4.5) anatirittaṃ nāma akappiyakataṃ hoti, appaṭiggahitakataṃ hoti, anuccāritakataṃ hoti, ahatthapāse kataṃ hoti, abhuttāvinā kataṃ hoti, bhuttāvinā pavāritena āsanā vuṭṭhitena kataṃ hoti, alam'etaṃ sabban'ti avuttaṃ hoti, na gilān'ātirittaṃ hoti

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu bhuttāvī pavārito anatirittaṃ khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā khādeyya vā bhuñjeyya vā, pācittiyaṃ.
yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ bhuttāviṃ pavāritaṃ anatirittena khādanīyena vā bhojanīyena vā abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyya, handa bhikkhu khāda vā bhuñja vā'ti jānaṃ āsādan'āpekkho, bhuttasmiṃ pācittiyaṃ.
ajjhohāre ajjhohāre āpatti dukkaṭassa. atiritte anatirittasaññī, āpatti dukkaṭassa. atiritte vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

3542.meaning1: not overstepping; not overshooting; not overturning

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, janapadaniruttiyā ca anabhiniveso hoti samaññāya ca anatisāro?

3543.meaning1: not past; not free from; not exempt; unavoidable; subject to
3543.commentary: (ANa) jaraṃ anatīto'ti jaraṃ anatikkanto, antojarāya eva carāmi.

examples.text: so imam'eva kāyaṃ upasaṃharati, ayam'pi kho kāyo evaṃdhammo evaṃbhāvī evaṃanatīto'ti
jarādhammo'mhi, jaraṃ anatīto'ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā.

3544.meaning1: impersonal; not oneself; non-subjective; not suitable to identify with; coreless; essenceless
3544.commentary: (SNa) sabbe dhammā anattā'ti sabbe catubhūmakadhammā anattā. (DHPa) anattā'ti mā jīyantu mā mīyantū'ti vase vattetuṃ na sakkā'ti avasavattan'aṭṭhena anattā attasuññā assāmikā anissarā'ti attho.

examples.text: sabbe dhammā anattā'ti, yadā paññāya passati, atha nibbindati dukkhe, esa maggo visuddhiyā.
anatte saṅkhāre anattā saṅkhārā'ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, anattaṃ viññāṇaṃ anattā viññāṇan'ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.

3545.grammar: masc, atta group, from na atta, neg
3545.meaning1: which is impersonal; non-self; not subject to identification

examples.text: anattani attamāniṃ, passa lokaṃ sadevakaṃ, niviṭṭhaṃ nāmarūpasmiṃ, idaṃ saccan'ti maññati.
rūpaṃ, bhikkhave, anattā vedanā anattā saññā anattā saṅkhārā anattā viññāṇaṃ anattā

3546.meaning1: not done by oneself; not personally performed

examples.text: atha kho aññatarassa bhikkhuno evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi, iti kira, bho, rūpaṃ anattā, vedanā anattā, saññā anattā, saṅkhārā anattā, viññāṇaṃ anattā, anattakatāni kammāni kam'attānaṃ phusissantī'ti?

3547.meaning1: not criticizing oneself; not blaming oneself

examples.text: pubb'āsave hitvā nave akubbaṃ, na chandagū no'pi nivissavādī, sa vippamutto diṭṭhigatehi dhīro, na limpati loke anattagarahī.

3548.meaningLit: discourse on desire for what is not oneself, etc.

3550.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of na atta, neg
3550.meaning1: as impersonal; as not oneself; as non-subjective
3550.construction:
na > an + atta + to
anatta + to

examples.text: so yadeva tattha hoti rūpagataṃ vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṅkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ, te dhamme aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato suññato anattato samanupassati.

ye'pi hi keci, bhikkhave, anāgatam'addhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ taṃ aniccato dakkhissanti dukkhato dakkhissanti anattato dakkhissanti rogato dakkhissanti bhayato dakkhissanti, te taṇhaṃ pajahissanti.

3551.meaning1: impersonal in nature; characterized by not being oneself

3553.commentary: (MNa) anatt'ādhīno'ti na attani adhīno, attano ruciyā kiñci kātuṃ na labhati.

3554.grammar: masc, loc sg of na atta, atta group, neg
3554.meaning1: in what is not oneself; within what is impersonal
3554.commentary: (ANa) anattani ca attā'ti anattani attā'ti evaṃsaññino'ti attho. (SNPa) anattani attamānin'ti anattani nāmarūpe attamāniṃ.

examples.text: aniccaṃ aniccato dakkhuṃ, dukkham'addakkhu dukkhato, anattani anattā'ti, asubhaṃ asubhat'addasuṃ, sammādiṭṭhisamādānā, sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ upaccagun'ti
anattani, bhikkhave, attā'ti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso.

3555.meaningLit: discourse on not oneself being conducive to complete quenching

3556.meaning1: not belonging to a self; not related to a self; not one's own
3556.construction:
na > an + atta + aniya
anatta + aniya
3556.commentary: (SNa) anattaniyan'ti na attano santakaṃ, attano parikkhārabhāvena suññatan'ti attho.

examples.text: yaṃ kho, bhikkhu, anattaniyaṃ, tatra te chando pahātabbo'ti. aññātaṃ, bhagavā, aññātaṃ, sugatā'ti.

3557.meaningLit: discourse on not belonging to a self

3558.construction:
na > an + atta + anīya
anatta + anīya
3558.commentary: (SNa) anattaniyan'ti na attano santakaṃ, attano parikkhārabhāvena suññatan'ti attho.

examples.text: upādiyamaññamānā, ath'ābhinandamāno ca, aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ anattā ca, anattanīyaṃ rajanīyasaṇṭhitaṃ, rādhasurādhena te dasā'ti.

3560.meaning1: not beneficial for oneself; without personal advantage; not good for one
3560.construction:
na > a + atta + [n] + eyya
anatta + eyya
3560.commentary: (THa) anattaneyyam'etan'ti etaṃ navakamm'ādhiṭṭhān'ādikaṃ attano atth'āvahaṃ na hotī'ti attho.

3561.meaning1: not harming oneself; not self-torturing; not self-mortifying

examples.text: so anattan'tapo aparan'tapo diṭṭh'eva dhamme nicchāto nibbuto sītībhūto sukhappaṭisaṃvedī brahmabhūtena attanā viharati.
yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa sāmaṃ cīvaraṃ datvā kupito anattamano acchindeyya vā acchindāpeyya vā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
so kupito anattamano sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvattati. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ūmibhayassa bhīto sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvatto.

3563.grammar: fem, abstr, comp, from na anattamana, neg
3563.construction:
na > an + atta + manas + tā
anattamana + tā
3563.commentary: (VINa) tāya ca anattamanatāyā'ti yāya anattamano'ti vutto… imehi dvīhi vedanākkhandhaṃ dasseti.

examples.text: tatra, bhikkhave, tathāgato na c'eva anattamano hoti, na ca anattamanataṃ paṭisaṃvedeti, anavassuto ca viharati sato sampajāno.
appatīto'ti tena ca kopena tena ca dosena tāya ca anattamanatāya tāya ca anabhiraddhiyā appatīto hoti.

3564.meaning1: unhappy words; words of displeasure; moan; gripe

examples.text: disvā ca pana maṃ so bhikkhu akusalaṃ āpajjamānaṃ kiñci'd'eva desaṃ kāyena anattamano ahosi. anattamano samāno anattamanavacanaṃ maṃ so bhikkhu avaca. anattamanavacan'āhaṃ tena bhikkhunā vutto samāno anattamano ahosiṃ.

3565.meaning1: words of displeasure; expression of annoyance
3565.commentary: (MNa) anattamanavācan'ti are pāpi dāsi attano pamāṇaṃ na jānāsi, kiṃ aggiṃ sīto'ti maññasi, idāni taṃ sikkhāpessāmī'tiādīni vadamānā kupitavacanaṃ nicchāresi.

examples.text: kiṃ, je, divātaraṃ uṭṭhāsī'ti? na khv'ayye, kiñcī'ti. no vata re kiñci, pāpi dāsi, divātaraṃ uṭṭhāsī'ti kupitā anattamanā anattamanavācaṃ nicchāresi.

3567.meaningLit: discourse on the characteristic of not oneself

3568.meaning1: recognition of impersonality; perception of non-self; concept of no self
3568.commentary: (ANa) dukkhe anattasaññā'ti yaṃ dukkhaṃ, taṃ avasavattanākārena anattā'ti uppajjanakasaññā.
3568.notes: ten peceptions 1. aniccasaññā, 2. anattasaññā, 3. asubhasaññā, 4. ādīnavasaññā, 5. pahānasaññā, 6. virāgasaññā, 7. nirodhasaññā, 8. sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā, 9. sabbasaṅkhāresu anicchāsaññā, 10. ānāpānassati.

examples.text: aniccasaññino, bhikkhave, anattasaññā saṇṭhāti. anattasaññī asmimānasamugghātaṃ pāpuṇāti diṭṭh'eva dhamme nibbānan'ti.
cha, bhikkhave, ānisaṃse sampassamānena alam'eva bhikkhunā sabbadhammesu anodhiṃ karitvā anattasaññaṃ upaṭṭhāpetuṃ. katame cha?

3569.meaning1: fortified by the perception of non-self (in)

examples.text: dukkhe anattasaññāparicitena, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno cetasā bahulaṃ viharato imasmiñ'ca saviññāṇake kāye bahiddhā ca sabbanimittesu ahaṅ'kāra-mamaṅ'kāra-mān'āpagataṃ mānasaṃ hoti vidhāsamatikkantaṃ santaṃ suvimuttaṃ.

3570.meaning1: who is conscious of impersonality; who perceives non-self

examples.text: aniccasaññino, bhikkhave, anattasaññā saṇṭhāti. anattasaññī asmimānasamugghātaṃ pāpuṇāti diṭṭh'eva dhamme nibbānan'ti.
yo'pi hetu yo'pi paccayo viññāṇassa uppādāya, so'pi anattā. anattasambhūtaṃ, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ kuto attā bhavissati!

3578.meaning1: not belonging to oneself; depending on another's will
3578.commentary: (MNa) anatt'ādhīno'ti na attani adhīno, attano ruciyā kiñci kātuṃ na labhati.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso dāso assa anatt'ādhīno par'ādhīno na yenakāmaṃgamo. so aparena samayena tamhā dāsabyā mucceyya att'ādhīno apar'ādhīno bhujisso yenakāmaṃgamo.

3579.grammar: masc, acc sg of na atta, atta group, neg
3579.meaning1: what is not self; something other than self (object)
3579.construction:
na > an + atta + ānaṃ
anatta + ānaṃ

examples.text: attanā'va attānaṃ sañjānāmī'ti vā assa saccato thetato diṭṭhi uppajjati, attanā'va anattānaṃ sañjānāmī'ti vā assa saccato thetato diṭṭhi uppajjati, anattanā'va attānaṃ sañjānāmī'ti vā assa saccato thetato diṭṭhi uppajjati

3580.meaning1: observing the impersonal nature (of); watching non-self; seeing as not oneself

examples.text: iti imesu chasu ajjhattikabāhiresu āyatanesu anatt'ānupassī viharati. ayaṃ vuccat'ānanda, anattasaññā.

3581.meaningLit: discourse on seeing what is not oneself

3583.meaning1: not praising oneself; not elevating oneself

examples.text: na kho pan'āhaṃ att'ukkaṃsako paravambhī araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevāmi, anatt'ukkaṃsako aparavambhī'ham'asmi.
puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu anatt'ukkaṃsako hoti aparavambhī. yam'p'āvuso, bhikkhu anatt'ukkaṃsako hoti aparavambhī, ayam'pi dhammo sovacassakaraṇo.

3584.meaning1: fact of not praising oneself; fact of not elevating oneself
3584.construction:
na > an + atta + ukkaṃsaka + tā
anattukkaṃsaka + tā

examples.text: etam'ahaṃ, brāhmaṇa, anatt'ukkaṃsakataṃ aparavambhitaṃ attani sampassamāno bhiyyo pallomam'āpādiṃ araññe vihārāya.

3585.meaning1: not praising oneself; not elevating oneself

examples.text: iti pubb'eva kho pan'assa dussīlyaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti, susīlyaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ, ayañ'ca sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā ariyānaṃ apaccanīkatā saddhammasaññatti anatt'ukkaṃsanā aparavambhanā. evam'ass'ime aneke kusalā dhammā sambhavanti sammādiṭṭhipaccayā.
yāva'd'eva anatthāya, ñattaṃ bālassa jāyati, hanti bālassa sukk'aṃsaṃ, muddham'assa vipātayaṃ.
evarūpo, bhikkhave, puggalo ajjhupekkhitabbo na sevitabbo na bhajitabbo na payirupāsitabbo. taṃ kissa hetu? akkoseyya'pi maṃ paribhāseyya'pi maṃ anattham'pi maṃ kareyyā'ti.

3587.meaning2: of no meaning or use; hurtful

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, āvuso yamaka, gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo, so ca ārakkhasampanno. tassa koci'd'eva puriso uppajjeyya anatthakāmo ahitakāmo ayogakkhemakāmo jīvitā voropetu'kāmo.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, araññe pavane mahantaṃ ninnaṃ pallalaṃ. tam'enaṃ mahāmigasaṅgho upanissāya vihareyya. tassa koci'd'eva puriso uppajjeyya anatthakāmo ahitakāmo ayogakkhemakāmo.

3589.grammar: pp of na atthaṃ gacchati, comp, neg
3589.meaning1: (of the sun) not set; not gone down

examples.text: anatthaṅ'gate vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa. anatthaṅ'gate anatthaṅ'gatasaññī, anāpatti.
atthaṅ'gate atthaṅ'gatasaññī ovadati, āpatti pācittiyassa. atthaṅ'gate vematiko ovadati, āpatti pācittiyassa. atthaṅ'gate anatthaṅ'gatasaññī ovadati, āpatti pācittiyassa.
akālacīvaraṃ nāma anatthate kathine ekādasamāse uppannaṃ, atthate kathine sattamāse uppannaṃ, kāle'pi ādissa dinnaṃ, etaṃ akālacīvaraṃ nāma.
cīvaradānasamayo nāma anatthate kathine vassānassa pacchimo māso, atthate kathine pañcamāsā, cīvaradānasamayo'ti bhuñjitabbaṃ.

3593.grammar: fem, abstr, from na attha, neg
3593.meaning1: useless things; worthless activities; doing what is unbeneficial
3593.construction:
na > an + √ar + tha + tā
anattha + tā

examples.text: ussūraseyyā paradārasevanā, verappasavo ca anatthatā ca, pāpā ca mittā sukadariyatā ca, ete cha ṭhānā purisaṃ dhaṃsayanti.

3594.meaning2: not seeing the goal or what is beneficial

3595.meaning1: unbeneficial saying; unprofitable verse; useless poem

examples.text: sahassam'api ce vācā, anatthapadasaṃhitā, ekaṃ atthapadaṃ seyyo, yaṃ sutvā upasammati.
yo c'āyaṃ attakilamath'ānuyogo dukkho anariyo anatthasañhito.

atha kho bhagavato etadahosi, dīgharattaṃ visuddho kho ayaṃ yakkho, yaṃ kiñci maṃ pañhaṃ pucchissati, sabbaṃ taṃ atthasañhitaṃ'y'eva pucchissati, no anatthasañhitaṃ. yañ'c'ass'āhaṃ puṭṭho byākarissāmi, taṃ khippam'eva ājānissatī'ti.

3597.commentary: (MNa) anatthasaṃhitan'ti na atthasaṃhitaṃ na vaḍḍhinissitaṃ. (ANa) anatthasaṃhitan'ti na lokiyalok'uttar'ātthanissitaṃ katvā katheti.

examples.text: yo c'āyaṃ kāmesu kāmasukhallik'ānuyogo hīno gammo pothujjaniko anariyo anatthasaṃhito, yo c'āyaṃ attakilamath'ānuyogo dukkho anariyo anatthasaṃhito. ete kho, bhikkhave, ubho ante anupagamma majjhimā paṭipadā tathāgatena abhisambuddhā cakkhukaraṇī ñāṇakaraṇī upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.

kālena vakkhāmi no akālena, bhūtena vakkhāmi no abhūtena, saṇhena vakkhāmi no pharusena, atthasaṃhitena vakkhāmi no anatthasaṃhitena, mettacitto vakkhāmi, no dos'antaro'ti, ime pañca dhammā ajjhattaṃ upaṭṭhāpetabbā

3598.commentary: (MNa) anatthavādī'ti akāraṇanissitaṃ vattā (ANa) anatthavādī'ti atthaṃ na vadati, anatthaṃ vadati nāma. (ANa) anatthaṃ vadati, no atthan'ti anatthavādī.

examples.text: evarūpo c'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo vuccati akālavādī'ti'pi, abhūtavādī'ti'pi, anatthavādī'ti'pi, adhammavādī'ti'pi, avinayavādī'ti'pi.
samphappalāpī hoti akālavādī abhūtavādī anatthavādī adhammavādī avinayavādī, anidhānavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti akālena anapadesaṃ apariyantavatiṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ.

3599.grammar: masc, dat sg of na atthāya, neg (+gen)
3599.construction:
na > an + √ar + tha + āya
atthāya + āya

examples.text: ta'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, hoti bahujan'āhitāya bahujan'āsukhāya, bahuno janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ.

ye te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū duggahitehi sutt'antehi byañjanappatirūpakehi atthañ'ca dhammañ'ca paṭibāhanti te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bahujan'āhitāya paṭipannā bahujan'āsukhāya, bahuno janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ.
